description: The bar chart in Figure 7 illustrates the CoLeG-R values for different model scales in the LLaMA-2 family when scaling up the SFT dataset. The horizontal axis represents the model scales, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-E (%)". For the chart on the right, the label should be CoLeG-R (%). The vertical axis has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a model scale and containing four bars corresponding to different SFT datasets, as indicated by the legend: no SFT, +SFT on D0, +SFT on D0, D1, and +SFT on D0, D1, D2. The bars are colored according to the legend, with no SFT being blue, +SFT on D0 being pink, +SFT on D0, D1 being blue with diagonal lines, and +SFT on D0, D1, D2 being pink with diagonal lines. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, but the groups are ordered by model scale. The approximate values for the bars are: for LLaMA-2-7B, the values range from around 3% to 45%; for LLaMA-2-13B, the values range from around 25% to 45%; and for LLaMA-2-70B, the values range from around 40% to 48%. No bars are visually emphasized.
